messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert for /v1/stream detected at 1998887776. p99 latency > 3.2s for last 6m, p95 ~1.1s. Error rate unchanged. Affected model: redwood-7b-int8-v2. Incident ID INC-1998. Paging oncall-sre.

oncall-sre: I'm on it. Pulling dashboards (latency by route/model, streaming stalls, backend GPU queues).

kevin: ran a quick correlation — there's a config push earlier today: ml-infra rolled out an int8 calibration profile at 1998887400. Rollout 100% to inference fleet.

ml-infra: confirmed: int8-calib v2 applied to redwood-7b-int8-v2 at 1998887400. Calibration steps included new dequant kernel selection and tighter per-layer clipping. No errors surfaced during canary.

sarah: looking at streaming agent logs — I see repeated kv-cache dequant retries and thread-level stalls. sample: ```WARN streaming: dequantize_slow layer=22 latency_ms=1280 attempts=3 pid=4021``` and stack shows gpu-copy + dequant kernel wait.

oncall-sre: gpu metrics show increased SM utilization but also higher memory-copy stalls on nodes serving long-context streams. p99 tokens-per-second dropped.

lia: starting immediate mitigation: can we route a subset of streaming traffic to the fp16 variant? product-ops, want to avoid broad customer impact.

deploy-bot: Routing request: `reconfigure-router --route /v1/stream --model redwood-7b-fp16-v1 --weight 30% --sticky false` submitted by lia at 1998887820.

mike-cs: Notifying top customers on streaming plan. So far 2 customers reported 'slow responses' since ~1998887600. We'll mark as potential degraded performance.

oncall-sre: After routing 30% to fp16 (1998887820), p99 for cohort dropped to ~1.6s within 2 minutes. Continuing ramp.

kevin: hypothesis: int8 dequant kernel introduced a regression for long sequences (kv-contention + memcpy path). It didn't show in canary because canary traffic was short-context.

ml-infra: rolling rollback of int8-calib v2 to previous stable profile (int8-calib v1). Command: `calib-manager rollback --model redwood-7b-int8-v2 --from v2 --to v1 --scope fleet` executed at 1998887845.

deploy-bot: Rollback job started, streaming nodes will pick changes within ~30s. Logs: ```rollback: started job 8241 -> applying profile v1; affected nodes 120; progress 0/120```

sarah: monitoring logs during rollback: dequant warnings dropping, few nodes still showing slowdown but overall token throughput improving. Sample: ```WARN streaming: dequantize_slow layer=22 latency_ms=450 attempts=1 pid=4123```

oncall-sre: At 1998887870 p95 back to 0.9s, p99 1.4s fleet-wide. Rolling back fp16 routing to 0% and resuming normal routing.

mike-cs: CS update sent to affected customers: short message + ETA for post-incident notes. No functional failures, only latency.

product-ops: Any customers that experienced timeouts? We need to compile list for contractual SLA review.

mike-cs: Two customers saw client-side timeouts (3 occurrences total), logged as potential SLA hits. We'll follow-up with affected teams.

kevin: Root cause provisional: int8-calib v2 changed dequant kernel selection which regresses long-context streaming paths (KV dequant memcpy stalls under certain memory layouts). Canary missed it due to short-context traffic distribution.

lia: Action items: 1) revert int8-calib v2 (done), 2) add long-context synthetic canary tests to calibration pipeline, 3) add automatic pressure test for dequant memcpy under mixed batch lengths. Assigning owners: ml-infra (kernel selection test), eng-runtime (KV dequant telemetry), oncall-sre (postmortem).

oncall-sre: I'll stay on incident to collect timeline and metrics until handoff. If no regressions in next 30m, we'll close incident.

product-ops: documenting impact: p99 breached for ~14m, small number of customer timeouts (3), degraded UX for streaming customers.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-1998 state updated -> mitigated at 1998887892. Follow-up postmortem requested.

mike-cs: Confirmed follow-up meeting scheduled 1998888500 to review customer impact and next steps.

oncall-sre: Final note: consider adding a hot-fix path in routing to immediately fallback to fp16/pinned models when streaming p99 > threshold. Creating RFC ticket.

product-ops: Thanks everyone. Good remote triage. We'll collect logs/traces for the postmortem and tag owners. :white_check_mark:
